name: Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 2.1 ExSxPAR!!
original_name: 月に寄りそう乙女の作法2.1 E×S×PAR!!
source: The game divided into 3 episodes: "Est After Story", "Paruko After Story," and "Tsuki ni Yorisou Otome no Sahou 0" that focuses on Ookura Aeon's college days.
translation: 本作分为3个篇章：“Est后日谈”、“Paruko后日谈”，以及聚焦大仓爱音大学生活的《月下相依的少女之礼0》。
